verdict.reasons: Product family matches tape20 (upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll). Branding is authentic, owner-approved sleeve captions are present, and the required watermark (AFP | 09134922013) is clearly visible. Irrigation geometry and soil placement are visually plausible. Minor advisory issues: the installed dark lines are coiled/looped in a way that is not technically accurate for operating drip-tape laterals, and there is slight visual compression between the product and the soil line. Neither of these constitutes a core defect under the provided editorial review rules.

focused_physical_review.reason: A clear, uninterrupted soil gap is visible around the base of the package, particularly to the left and front, separating it from the irrigation system. However, a short, distinct segment of the black irrigation line emerges directly from the right side of the package's mid-section, extending outward to connect with the loose coiled section on the ground. This direct physical connection means a line touches the package. While there is a coiled section of pipe on the ground, it is a standard part of the continuous installed lateral line, not a distinct extra uninstalled product coil. No white ribbon, strap, or tape tails are visible protruding from the carton's sides or base.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: line_touches_or_crosses_package

acceptance_decision.source: user requested practical >=90 acceptance; actual saved vision evidence retained
